objective: Coordinate the existing claim, practice, lifecycle, and blind-spot suites into an exact-candidate readiness decision without replacing their authority or confusing machine checks with human outcomes.
scopeBoundary: A system-ready result certifies the repository's deterministic and bounded LLM evaluation contract for one exact candidate. Application-ready and production-ready require separately recorded human states.

criteria.name: Application comprehension
criteria.description: A hiring reader can identify Jamie's target work, direct contribution, usable outcomes, strongest proof, and next action without reconstructing the archive.
failureExamples: The reader must infer the target role
Archive depth appears before the hiring argument
criteria.remediationGuidance: Move the answer forward, reduce repeated setup, and route to two or three decisive proofs.

criteria.name: Claim and source governance
criteria.description: Consequential public claims remain canonical, source-backed, bounded, cited where required, and no stronger than the Knowledge Bank record.
failureExamples: A URL is treated as a seal of authority
Not recovered becomes did not exist
A private locator appears publicly
criteria.remediationGuidance: Repair the canonical source, evidence, claim, or boundary before revising public copy.

criteria.name: Exact role and collective credit
criteria.description: Jamie's supported actions are visible while collaborators, institutions, legislation, and collective outcomes retain their proper credit.
failureExamples: Coalition importance becomes Jamie's sole authorship
Careful collective language erases Jamie's documented action
criteria.remediationGuidance: Separate individual action, collective work, institutional authority, and outcome causality.

criteria.name: Operating sequence, outcomes, and transfer
criteria.description: Primary proof cases show how an emerging condition became usable through decisions, implementation, use, outcome, and durable handoff.
evidenceRequirements: At least two primary case studies
failureExamples: A list of duties replaces a sequence
Outputs are presented as outcomes without use evidence
criteria.remediationGuidance: Show the smallest accurate chain from condition through handoff while preserving domain differences.

criteria.name: Recent and present-tense capability
criteria.description: The portfolio demonstrates current technical project, product operations, implementation, knowledge-system, and evaluation practice rather than relying only on historical importance.
evidenceRequirements: Connection between current method and prior practice
failureExamples: All convincing evidence is historical
Current experiments are described as deployed products
criteria.remediationGuidance: Use bounded recent practice and label prototype, method, consulting, and production status precisely.

criteria.name: Artifact and visual proof
criteria.description: Readers can inspect representative work while evidentiary, representative, reconstructed, protected, and rights-pending media remain distinct.
failureExamples: A generic image is presented as event evidence
Protected media is exposed for visual polish
criteria.remediationGuidance: Prefer actual approved artifacts and label what an image can and cannot establish.

criteria.name: Resume, contact, and application path
criteria.description: The canonical resume, approved contact route, proof destinations, and website chronology reinforce one coherent application packet.
failureExamples: A file exists but is not the approved resume
The site and resume contradict one another
criteria.remediationGuidance: Fix front-door application artifacts before expanding secondary content.

criteria.name: Responsive and accessible experience
criteria.description: The exact rendered candidate remains legible, stable, keyboard-usable, and comprehensible across required widths and assistive interaction paths.
failureExamples: Text or controls overlap
Focus is invisible
Citation information depends on hover
criteria.remediationGuidance: Repair reading order, layout constraints, focus, contrast, and semantics before ornament.

criteria.name: Runtime, routes, indexing, and release behavior
criteria.description: The application builds reproducibly, routes and health contracts work, staging remains noindex, and production state is bound to an exact candidate.
evidenceRequirements: Robots, sitemap, health, and Docker evidence
failureExamples: A stale score certifies a changed build
Production indexing is enabled without approval
criteria.remediationGuidance: Repair deterministic release behavior and bind every result to the reviewed candidate.

criteria.name: Maintainability and contributor comprehension
criteria.description: A contributor with only the repository can ingest, query, evaluate, improve, and hand off the system without inventing a parallel source of truth.
failureExamples: The latest pass cannot be reproduced
A helper writes outside canonical lifecycle stages
criteria.remediationGuidance: Reduce duplicate concepts and document authority, state transitions, and exact commands.

criteria.name: Collaborator corroboration
criteria.description: Where consequential individual-role language depends on shared work, a named human process can confirm, revise, decline, or protect it.
evidenceRequirements: Public-safe corroboration receipt or explicit not-required decision
failureExamples: A planned collaborator review is described as completed
Private feedback is committed
criteria.remediationGuidance: Request bounded review and retain only public-safe disposition and learning.

criteria.name: Independent hiring-reader validation
criteria.description: A real intended reader can identify role, contribution, proof, and next action from the exact shared candidate.
failureExamples: An LLM score is called recruiter validation
A reader tests a different candidate
criteria.remediationGuidance: Run the short comprehension protocol and record only aggregate public-safe learning.

criteria.name: Exact-candidate approval and cutover
criteria.description: Jamie approves the exact candidate for sharing or deployment, with indexing, rights, rollback, and post-deploy states separately visible.
failureExamples: Approval of a proposal is treated as approval of a later candidate
Deployment approval is inferred from machine checks
criteria.remediationGuidance: Present the exact candidate and request the specific share or production decision.

stopPolicy.failureCondition: At the iteration limit, preserve the strongest non-regressing candidate and name unresolved criteria without claiming readiness.
